span.p:
Alternator whine
→ check charging system,
consider a noise filter

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Clean when the source
runs on its own battery,
nothing else plugged in?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Source or cable fault
→ swap and re-test

div.style: color: #1e293b !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Disconnect 12 V accessories
one at a time.
Does one silence it?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does the noise change with
that device's settings -
brightness, speed, mode?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
General rail noise
→ isolate the audio supply

div.style: color: #1e293b !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PWM switching noise.
Filter at that device,
or give it its own supply.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Load-related dip
→ check grounds and gauge

div.style: color: #1e293b !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Isolated DC-DC on the audio device
= silence with no bass loss
